issues.desc: The INIT explains the dispatch defect and chosen architecture, but CHK-001 is framed only as an internal registry deliverable and the background never states one concise user-observable completion outcome. Add an outcome such as: supported roles/aliases dispatch with the correct story/item cardinality and role-safe prompt; unknown or invalid combinations fail with clear diagnostics; reviewers and verification-intent agents never receive implementer mutation/commit guidance. This gives the user a direct way to recognize completion, while the existing CHK-002/003 coverage makes the issue advisory rather than blocking.
